title: Equity vs Cash
hook: A paycheck gets spent. Ownership keeps growing while you sleep.
statement: Ownership compounds. Labor doesn't. Own assets.
explainer: Cash disappears. If none of it becomes equity, you're running in place.
sop: Mark each income source cash or equity.
Move one cash expense into equity.
equation_example: Assets $150,000 minus Liabilities $40,000 = $110,000 Net Worth. Watch it rise.
question: Write your net worth today. Real numbers.
closing_statement: Own what grows, not just what spends.
